noProvider.admin: Picture tools are not set up in this workspace yet.
noProvider.member: Ask your workspace admin to set up picture tools.

changed.none: {title} finished, but nothing new came back.
changed.one: {title} added a new layer, "{name}". Your original is untouched.
changed.many: {title} added {count} new layers. Your originals are untouched.

maskBar.hint: Hide takes parts of the layer away. Show brings them back. Hold Alt to switch for one stroke.

brush.hintTarget: Paint over the part of "{layer}" you want to change. The painted area shows in red.
brush.hintNone: Select a picture layer first. Text layers have no pixels to paint on.

subject.intro: Click the thing you want to cut out, or drag a box around it. To leave something out, choose "Leave out" below, then click it (with a keyboard, Shift-click does the same). You can also just type its name.
subject.cuttingFrom: Cutting from {name}. Select another picture layer to cut from that one instead.
subject.optionsHint: Each option becomes its own layer.
subject.needInput: Click the picture, drag a box, or type a name first.
subject.paidNote: This sends the picture to an AI provider and adds what it finds as new layers. It is a paid call on every press.

crop.title: Crop {label}
crop.intro: Drag the box, or type the numbers. The part outside the box is hidden, not thrown away: you can open Crop again to widen it, and Undo puts it back.

layers.empty: This picture has no layers yet. Upload an image, add text, or create a picture with AI.
layers.name: Name
layers.lockedHint: Locked: unlock to move, resize or flip.

canvas.label: Thumbnail canvas
canvas.help: Select a layer, then use the arrow keys to nudge it by one pixel, or hold Shift for ten. Hold Space and drag, or drag with two fingers, to move around. Scroll or pinch to zoom; press 0 to fit the picture, 1 for actual size.

editor.croppedTool: This picture is cropped. Open Crop and choose "Remove crop" first, so this works on the whole picture.
editor.finishMaskFirst: Press Done or Cancel to finish the mask first.
editor.noProviderFallback: This workspace has no AI provider set up for it.
